blurb: Named by TripAdvisor among the top 10% of attractions worldwide, our 6,000-square-foot gallery-originally built in 1840-still boasts its original brick walls and timeworn wood floors. More than “just” a gallery, it’s a creative sanctuary where artists from around the world come to connect, collaborate, and be inspired.
